{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the existence of 'LOYAL' customers
loyal_exists = 'loyal' in sales['customer_segment'].unique()

# Check for completed orders from LOYAL customers
completed_loyal = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]
completed_loyal_count = len(completed_loyal)

# Check if any QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) are in the LOYAL completed set
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
qa_in_loyal_completed = len(qa_orders[qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'])

# Check if any refunded orders are in the LOYAL completed set
refunded_loyal = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'refunded')]
refunded_in_loyal_completed = len(refunded_loyal)

# Print findings
print(f'LOYAL customers exist: {loyal_exists}')
print(f'Completed LOYAL orders count: {completed_loyal_count}')
print(f'QA orders in LOYAL completed: {qa_in_loyal_completed}')
print(f'Refunded orders in LOYAL completed: {refunded_in_loyal_completed}')"}
